## Checklist

- [ ] `make fix` run, and the regenerated files are committed
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (validation, formatting, generated-file drift, tests)
- [ ] `year` is the first-public year and matches both the id suffix and the arXiv posting year
- [ ] `stage[0]` is where the contribution lands, not everything it touches
- [ ] `recursion` reflects what the paper actually ran, not what the method could do
- [ ] The TL;DR describes the loop in one sentence, with no "this paper" and no benchmark numbers
- [ ] Links resolve, and the entry is not already in the list

<!-- CI checks everything above except "why it belongs" and whether the labels are
